change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Number Format "Malay (1.3 juta)" is now "Words (1.3 million)": the words come from the plugin's language files in the page's language (English and Malay included, other languages through Language Overrides). Layouts that chose Malay switch to Words automatically, so Malay pages still show "1.3 juta".
The item's Color setting is now Number Color (color renamed to number_color). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load.

fix.item: The title's HTML element only accepts h1 to h6 or div; anything else falls back to div.
The script only watches the page for replaced elements inside the builder preview, not on every page view.

addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the title, meta text, content, image, icon and link of all items without deleting them.
Lucide Icon field, with Icon Pro installed: a Lucide icon instead of the UIkit icon.

note.item: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

addition.item: Count Style Odometer: each digit rolls into place, while separators, decimals and short-form letters stay put.
Number Format Short (1.3K, 3.4M) and Malay (1.3 ribu, 1.3 juta), counted in the same format.

change.item: Malay short numbers keep the number and word on one line (no-break space).

addition.item: Multiple counters in one element: content per item, style and grid settings once on the element. Grid columns per screen size, matching heights and a delay between items.
Each item can set its own number color.

change.item: Layouts made with 0.3 are converted when they load: the counter becomes the first item, so pages look the same.

addition.item: First release: count-up numbers with prefix and suffix, separators, decimals, gradient, icon layouts and card styles.
